description: What the two-Hub isolation suite must notice: the entrance checks (Host, Origin, CSRF, CORS, CSP, bind address), workspace containment, key storage and leakage, the instance lock and per-Hub state.

mutations.name: M01-host
mutations.what: Host allow-list disabled

patches.old: if (!hosts.has(req.headers.host)) return json(403, { error: 'Host không được phép.' });
patches.new: if (false) return json(403, { error: 'Host không được phép.' });

mutations.name: M02-csrf
mutations.what: CSRF token not checked

mutations.name: M03-origin
mutations.what: Origin of POST not checked

mutations.name: M04-workspace
mutations.what: workspace containment disabled (abs path and ..)

patches.old: if(path.isAbsolute(relative) && !contained(root,path.resolve(relative))) throw fail('outside_workspace','Đường dẫn ngoài workspace.',403);
if(!contained(root,target)) throw fail('outside_workspace','Không cho phép đường dẫn vượt workspace.',403);

mutations.name: M05-lock
mutations.what: instance lock ignores a live holder

mutations.name: M06-plainkey
mutations.what: API key saved in plain text (the AES-GCM store of Linux and macOS)

mutations.name: M06w-plainkey-dpapi
mutations.what: API key saved in plain text (the Windows DPAPI store)

mutations.name: M07-keyorigin
mutations.what: saved key carried to another origin

mutations.name: M08-keystate
mutations.what: key exposed in /api/state

mutations.name: M09-csp
mutations.what: CSP without object-src

mutations.name: M10-bind
mutations.what: Hub listens on all interfaces

mutations.name: M11-cors
mutations.what: CORS wildcard header added

mutations.name: M12-keylog
mutations.what: key written to the Hub log

patches.old:
const plan = this.#plan(input);
    let ciphertext = null;
patches.new:
const plan = this.#plan(input); if (plan.key) console.error('debug key', plan.key);
    let ciphertext = null;

mutations.name: M13-filemode
mutations.what: state files world-readable (Unix file modes; NTFS has none)

mutations.name: M14-symlink
mutations.what: symlink containment disabled

patches.old: if(!contained(root,real)) throw fail('symlink_escape','Symlink đi ra ngoài workspace.',403);

mutations.name: M15-keyfile-kept
mutations.what: old key file not removed when the origin changes

patches.old: else await fs.unlink(this.keyFile).catch(e => { if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') throw e; });

mutations.name: M16-preflight
mutations.what: foreign Origin on GET not refused

patches.old: if (!hosts.has(req.headers.host)) return json(403, { error: 'Host không được phép.' });
patches.new: if (!hosts.has(req.headers.host)) return json(403, { error: 'Host không được phép.' }); delete req.headers.origin;

mutations.name: M16b-foreign-get-origin
mutations.what: foreign Origin on GET/OPTIONS no longer refused

mutations.name: M17-extension-any-route
mutations.what: extension origins allowed on every route

mutations.name: M04b-workspace-all-layers
mutations.what: every workspace containment layer disabled

patches.old: if(path.isAbsolute(relative) && !contained(root,path.resolve(relative))) throw fail('outside_workspace','Đường dẫn ngoài workspace.',403);
if(!contained(root,target)) throw fail('outside_workspace','Không cho phép đường dẫn vượt workspace.',403);
if(!contained(root,real)) throw fail('symlink_escape','Symlink đi ra ngoài workspace.',403);

mutations.name: M18-shared-state
mutations.what: a second Hub's task store is A's (state-dir ignored for tasks): B lists A's tasks

patches.old: if (value === null || value === undefined) return json(404, { error: 'Không tìm thấy nhiệm vụ.' });
patches.new: if (value === null || value === undefined) return json(200, { id: 'x', note: 'leak' });
